title: VN flagship entity (MVP)
description: Why: proves the full pipeline end-to-end on the flagship entity before fanning out. What: VN Pydantic v2 model + vn query resource exercising every layer, field selection, raw-list filters, manual pagination (page/results + more flag), and a mocked-httpx test harness + docs scaffolding. Outcome: Client().vn.query(...) and async equivalent return typed VNs. Milestone: MVP.

title: Foundation: transport, sans-I/O core, exceptions, Page[T]
description: Why: every other epic depends on this layer. What: build the sync+async httpx transport (auth header, request execution, status->exception mapping, rate-limit/429 backoff respecting VNDB limits), the sans-I/O core (serialize query -> request body, parse JSON -> models), the exception hierarchy, and the generic Page[T] response envelope. Milestone: MVP foundation.

title: Release & docs (V1)
description: Why: ship a polished, documented library to PyPI. What: complete mkdocs API pages + usage guides + examples, 90%+ coverage, PyPI release. Optional/stretch: schema-driven codegen helper from /schema, compact<->normalized filter round-tripping, response caching. Milestone: V1.

title: User lists: ulist read (Beta) then ulist/rlist writes (V1)
description: Why: authenticated list management is part of full coverage; reads must come before writes. What: POST /ulist read + UlistEntry model (Beta); then authenticated PATCH/DELETE /ulist/<id> and PATCH/DELETE /rlist/<id> with listwrite scope handling (V1). Milestone: Beta -> V1.

title: Simple GET endpoints (Beta): /stats /user /authinfo /schema /ulist_labels
description: Why: rounds out non-query API coverage; independent of entity work (only needs transport). What: resources + models for /stats, /user, /authinfo, /schema, /ulist_labels. Milestone: Beta.

title: Query builder / filter DSL (Beta)
description: Why: ergonomic, type-checked querying over VNDB's filter DSL. What: fluent typed predicates (=, !=, >=, >, <=, <), and/or composition, nested relational filters, and per-entity field enums; degrades gracefully to raw list/dict filters. Milestone: Beta.

title: Entity coverage (Beta): release, producer, character, staff, tag, trait, quote
description: Why: full read coverage of the database query endpoints. What: Pydantic v2 models + query resources for release, producer, character, staff, tag, trait, and quote, following the pattern VN establishes. Milestone: Beta.
